title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of Intersecting Melodies — Episode3 I'd Like to Talk

meta.Event Outline: Ichika has her eye on the last copy of a CD by an artist who creates Miku songs, but so does a fellow shopper—a girl with long hair. Surprisingly, the girl allows Ichika to take it. Putting the pieces together, Mafuyu realizes the girl in question was Kanade...

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seem so happy today, Ichika.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Your voice sounds like it's filled with smiles and joy! Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, actually... I found that person I was talking about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which person? Oh, the one who gave you that CD...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, so I should be able to lend her my CD.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's great, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But this person's technically a complete stranger, right? It's a miracle that you found them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's apparently a friend of one of the other class representatives, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mafuyu Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I told her about what happened at the music shop and she said that her friend had told her the same story...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So I asked Asahina yesterday about handing that CD over to her friend for me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you know what this person's like?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I only got a brief description, but she's apparently around our age according to Asahina...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And she even composes her own songs...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's a composer...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, that's what I was told.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's so cool!
That means she's just like you guys!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, she's been doing it much longer than us. Since before junior high school from what I heard...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That long...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You girls could learn quite a lot about making your own music by talking to her, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, probably.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I wanna know more!
What kind of music does she make?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Asahina gave me a link to her videos. How about we watch some together?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! This is awesome...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I agree. It's like each note's been painstakingly chosen to be where it is. Not only that, the melody and lyrics convey such powerful emotions.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This song... Could it really be...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Have you heard this before, Hona?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Maybe... I do housework for this one person, and this just sounds so similar to the music they make...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, is that true?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm not certain...!
I've only ever heard them play a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But that may not be a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You may be right.
I may have to ask them to play something for me the next time I go over to their house.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I still can't believe that a girl our age can make music that's this amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't either. High schooler or not, it's hard to find music of this kind of quality.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At the same time, this sort of isn't what we're trying to go for as a band...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's nothing like Leo/need.
But I totally wanna hear how this person makes music like this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She seemed to want that CD just as much as I did... Does that mean she likes Miku songs too...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If so, it'd be nice if we could become friends...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seem very interested in her, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh? Yeah, I am.
I'd like to talk to her since she also seems to like Miku songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why don't you ask Asahina to have her meet you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. If you explain what you just said to her, she may be willing to introduce you to her friend.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know... I feel like I've been asking Asahina for a lot of favors recently.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm with the others on this one. Why not just ask? You might not get another chance if you let this one go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Exactly. Plus, you'd be making a new friend to talk about Miku songs with, so I'm sure it'll be fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone.
My mind definitely has been wandering towards her, so I'll try asking Asahina about us possibly meeting...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome! Good luck, Ichi!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here's the CD I was talking about yesterday, Asahina. Thank you for doing this!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's my pleasure, Hoshino.
I'm sure she'll appreciate the gesture.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Asahina!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Asahina, would you mind helping me get ready for my next class? There's just so much to carry...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Understood!
I'll be there in just a second.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Sorry about that, Hoshino.
Anyway, where were we?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Nevermind, it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you need any help with anything, please feel free to ask.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're welcome. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Talk about bad timing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All the while knowing that I may not get this chance again...)
